title: Resolve executor
description: Resolve APP_URL and BEAM_URL from worker deploy-endpoints.json artifact, fallback to env/defaults for dev only.

defaultAppUrl.description: Dev-only fallback when APP_URL env and endpoints artifact are both empty

defaultBeamUrl.description: Dev-only fallback when BEAM_URL env and endpoints artifact are both empty

endpoints.description: Workspace-relative path to worker dist/deploy-endpoints.json, e.g. {workspaceRoot}/apps/flux2/dist/deploy-endpoints.json
